description: Trailing-tier exits against the fixed -5% / +8% bracket on the live rules

methodology.question: Do the live trailing-tier exits do better, worse, or no differently than the fixed -5% / +8% bracket of the #574 baseline, for the same entry signals at live timing?
methodology.signal: VotingSignal.evaluate_ranked_voting (MACD 13/34/8 hist beyond +/-0.1, RSI 14 at 30/70), 90-calendar-day window rescaled to the prior day's raw price level
methodology.timing: signal from bars through d-1; fills at day d open
methodology.entries: BUY with no position at the start of the day; whole shares (at the raw price) of position_pct x prior equity at the prior close; max 10 positions and 80% exposure counted before the open; cash

exit_modes.bracket: stop -5% / target +8% from the fill, fixed (the #574 baseline)
exit_modes.trailing: initial stop -5% from the fill, raised by the live trailing tiers, no target (legacy positions, whose take-profit legs lapsed at the 90-day GTC limit)
exit_modes.trailing_target: the same tiers plus the +8% target (new CLI entries: they still go out as brackets with an 8% take-profit leg, which lives until day 90, longer than the simulated holds)

methodology.signal_exit: a SELL signal closes the position at the open, in every mode unless the variant switches it off
methodology.trailing_raise: StateReconciler._trailing_level on a TrailingStopManager built as CostEfficientTradeCycle builds it (no broker, no ATR fetcher, stock TradingConfig); one raise a day from the close (the evening routine runs ten minutes before it), in force from the next session; MIN_STOP_GAP floor and the $0.01 rule are the reconciler's; run at the day's raw price level so the cent rounds as at the broker
methodology.morning_raise: the morning routine (09:20 ET) raises stops from the broker's price then, a pre-market print that daily bars do not have, so the main results leave that raise out. The sensitivity (LiveRules.morning_raise) runs the two trailing modes again with each held position's stop also raised from the day's open, before the day's range is checked (positions bought at that open are not held yet), and the evening raise as before. The open is the fully priced gap: a thin pre-market leaves the 09:20 price nearer the previous close, where the raise adds little. The bracket never raises, so each sensitivity run is compared with the same bracket and with its own evening-only run; these comparisons are reported under morning_raise_sensitivity and are not in paired_tests or the multiple-testing audit
inert_on_the_live_path: ATR (volatility_aware is off and the routines pass no atr_fetcher)
voter tightening (update_voter_signal is never called by the routines)
methodology.stop_fills: a session whose low reaches the stop fills at min(open, stop); both stop and target touched counts as the stop. Costs are a flat bps per side and an in-bar stop touch fills exactly at the stop price: any extra stop-market slippage falls harder on the trailing modes, which make many more near-the-price stop exits than the bracket, and the 0/5/10 bps grid cannot show that
methodology.signal_exit_convention: SELL-signal exits are a #574 baseline convention that the live system lacks (nothing in live sells on a signal); the moderate_no_signal_exit variant matches live exits and leads the Reading

moderate.label: Moderate sizing (2% of equity), SELL-signal exits kept

conservative.label: Conservative sizing (1% of equity), SELL-signal exits kept

moderate_no_signal_exit.label: Moderate sizing, SELL-signal exits off (stops and targets only; matches live exits)

methodology.sharpe: annualized, rf 0; 95% circular block bootstrap (20-day blocks, 2000 reps)
methodology.paired_sharpe: Sharpe(a) - Sharpe(b) on the daily returns of the two equity curves; the same 20-day blocks are drawn for both in each of 2000 replications (seed 0); p is twice the smaller share of replications on one side of zero
methodology.paired_return_test: Newey-West test of the mean daily return difference (research_cli.paired_return_test); this is the test the multiple-testing audit collects
methodology.alpha: daily OLS on equal-weight universe returns, annualized intercept, Newey-West (5 lags) t; cash earns 0
methodology.mean_hold_days: calendar days, closed trades by entry date
not_modelled: deferral of raises on non-replaceable stop orders (live skips them until a later run; the sim lands every raise at once)

stale local entry_price across a split (a known live quirk: live tiers on a position held through a split use the pre-split cost; the sim uses the split-adjusted entry; a separate live-code issue could refresh entry_price from the broker)

the evening raise uses the 16:00 close where the live routine at 15:50 sees the 15:50 price: a ten-minute information advantage, Sharpe-level timing noise of about +/-0.04 that is not in the bootstrap interval
stop-market slippage beyond the flat cost: it hurts the trailing modes more than the bracket (see stop_fills)

the morning routine's raise from the pre-market price (09:20 ET): daily bars have no pre-market price, and on gap days it differs from the price of the evening raise; see morning_raise_sensitivity, which stands the day's open in for it
intraday timing of the raise (the stop is in force from the next session, not for the last ten minutes of the day)
intraday decisions (the CLI can also trade on a partial day)
GTC renewal after 80 days (assumed seamless, as #587 does it)
the 90-day lapse of the take-profit leg in trailing_target (the target is kept as in the bracket)
GTT sells (skipped while a broker stop holds the shares)
caveats: universe picked with hindsight; benchmark is buy-and-hold of the same symbols
MACD threshold is in dollars, so signal frequency depends on price level
exit modes change how long positions are held, so the 10-position cap and the exposure limit block different entries: the strategies share signals, not trades
tiers and stops are measured from the open the position filled at, before costs

GOOGL's 2-for-1 split of 2014-04-03 is missing from gex.corporate_events (only the 2022-07-18 20:1 split is listed), so the adjusted GOOGL series has a phantom -49.7% day there; shared with the #574 baseline, immaterial here (no GOOGL position was open across that date in any mode or variant), not patched; the gex repo could be told

the flat cost grid understates stop-fill slippage for the trailing modes, so the intervals are wide and the point estimates lean negative for trailing under realistic stop slippage: the Reading is not 'no difference'

the morning raise is left out of the main results and it runs against the trailing modes: the sensitivity (the open as the 09:20 price) lowers their Sharpe, so the main trailing - bracket differences are, if anything, too favourable to the trailing modes

morning_raise_sensitivity.description: The two trailing modes again with the morning routine's raise (09:20 ET), the day's open standing in for its pre-market price; see methodology
